title: Pre Vizsla
description: During the Clone Wars, Pre Vizsla served as the governor of one of Mandalore's moons and posed as an ally of Duchess Satine Kryze—all while holding a shocking secret. He was covertly the leader of the Mandalorian Death Watch, a splinter group dedicated to returning Mandalore to its warrior past. A strong leader, Pre Vizsla wielded the fabled Darksaber, which gave him a strong claim on the Mandalorian throne for those invested in the old ways, but he made the mistake of allying with former Sith Lord Maul, who ultimately betrayed him.
